stages.note: Conditional by relevance but never bypass safety checks required by any candidate ingredient

stages.routing: activate goals plus answer-triggered branches, canonicalize aliases, deduplicate questions
only evidence-reviewed ingredient rules may yield doses

steps: validate goal IDs and preserve user rank
collect candidate ingredient IDs from goals (assessment only)
activate conditional branches using known answers
canonicalize only approved aliases and split fields
remove questions already answered; deduplicate by canonical ID
order safety-required before goal-specific; order remaining by highest goal rank
question_selection.unknown_policy: If a required safety answer is unknown or refused, do not show a personalized dose for the affected ingredient
question_selection.conflicts: Any safety block overrides relevance; goal rank affects order only

ingredient_group_policy: Variant forms can differ in suitability but must not count as independent benefit claims or duplicate daily nutrient totals
restrictions: No dose activation from draft matrices
No rank-based override of safety or evidence ceilings
No automatic regimen for pregnancy or suspected iron deficiency
